messages:
sam: FYI planning a terraform change that updates TGW route table and fixes cross-account IAM trust for monitoring-role. aiming for tonight's 00:30-01:30 UTC change window. PR + notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4523 :eyes:

deploybot: preflight checks started for PR #4523

lee: can we pin provider to 4.78.0? last upgrade caused drift in staging.

maria: strongly +1 to pin. also need to add `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment` ordering workaround. I'll push patch.

olivia: recommend smoke canary in eu-west-1 first with 10% traffic shift. if ok, shift rest.

sam: agreed. plan: run `terraform plan -target=module.tgw -var-file=canary.tfvars` in staging, then apply to staging, smoke tests, then schedule deploybot rollout to canary prod.

lee: I'll run the plan now and paste output.

lee: ```
$ terraform plan -target=module.tgw -out=plan.tfplan
No changes. (i.e., only metadata ordering fixes)
```

deploybot: preflight result: 1 warning (provider pin suggested), 0 errors. scheduling allowed.

sam: maria, did you push the provider pin + ordering fix? link?

maria: pushed in branch `fix/tgw-iam-ordering` -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/abcd1234 :shipit:

anil: rollback playbook attached. if routing regresses run:

anil: ```
# escape hatch
terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.tgw -state=backup-tgw.tfstate
# revert IAM trust
git checkout -- modules/iam/trust.tf
```

sam: deploybot, schedule window 2026-06-15T00:30:00Z - 2026-06-15T01:30:00Z, canary in eu-west-1 then monitor 20m, then full shift.

deploybot: scheduled: 2026-06-15 00:30 UTC. canary job created: job-7823. will post status updates here. :white_check_mark:

olivia: adding runbook link and smoke checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/runbooks/tgw-smoke

lee: I'll be oncall for the window. ping me @lee if anything noisy.

maria: tagging QA to run cross-account tests: @qa-team please verify cross-account log shipping during canary.

qa-team: on it, will report in 15m.

deploybot: canary apply succeeded in eu-west-1. logs: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/job-7823

qa-team: cross-account logs look good, no auth errors seen.

sam: holding 20m per plan. all good so far. prepping upgrade notes for release notes.

sam: commit for release notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/ef45d

deploybot: full rollout started. will update on completion.

deploybot: full rollout completed in 3 regions. latency regression <1ms. cost delta negligible. :tada:

olivia: great. confirm we'll backfill any drift snapshots? open issue for automated drift alert tracking.

sam: yes, I'll open issue.

sam: final: release notes published, changelog entry added, and provider pinned to 4.78.0. thanks everyone :pray:
